version.source: import { host } from "host"; const TARGET_PLAYER = "GoldennBullet"; const isWithinDemoArea = (x: number, z: number) => Math.abs(x) <= 32 && Math.abs(z) <= 32; try { const state = await host.player.getState(TARGET_PLAYER); if (!state || typeof state.x !== "number" || typeof state.z !== "number") { console.log("Player " + TARGET_PLAYER + " is offline or unavailable. No world action performed."); } else { const targetX = Math.round(state.x) + 2; const targetY = Math.round(state.y); const targetZ = Math.round(state.z); if (!isWithinDemoArea(targetX, targetZ)) { console.log("Target coordinates (" + targetX + ", " + targetY + ", " + targetZ + ") are outside the permitted demo area. No block placed."); } else { const result = await host.world.setBlock({ x: targetX, y: targetY, z: targetZ, type: "STONE" }); console.log("Placed STONE block: " + (result && result.accepted ? "accepted" : "failed")); } } } catch (err) { console.log("Player " + TARGET_PLAYER + " is offline or could not be queried: " + String(err)); }
